_: The Papenkasteel's grounds (Chateau de Stalle, Rue Papenkasteel / Rue Kinsendael; the hero model models/papenkasteel): what stands on its street frontages, from a look-only Street View check (Google car imagery Apr 2024, 2026-11-23, claude/places2; nothing stored, traced or shipped). Private grounds with no OSM polygon: the line is OURS (ring, city x / z m): the Rue Papenkasteel frontage 4.5 m in from the street's OSM centre line, the Rue Kinsendael frontage 4.5 m in from its centre line, closed back through the grounds by a 'none' stretch. tools/parkfence/build.mjs reads it; ?places2=old: not drawn.

fenceTypes.none: Rue Papenkasteel: a tall clipped beech / hornbeam hedge ~2.1 m right behind the narrow verge, trees over it (drawn by the garden kit: data/overrides.json gardenRestyle papenkasteel_hedge_*); Rue Kinsendael by the corner of the outbuilding range: the range's own whitewashed back wall stands on the street (the hero); the closing stretch through the grounds: nothing drawn
fenceTypes.mesh: Rue Kinsendael from the Rue Papenkasteel corner to the outbuilding range: a steep wooded bank (yews, chestnuts, ivy) with a dark mesh fence among the trunks
fenceTypes.brickwall: Rue Kinsendael west of the range: a tall old garden wall in dark red-brown brick, ~2.2-2.5 m, its top stepped down with the street and capped with a brick / tile coping, moss and ivy at its foot, the cobbled street right against it
